text:
mira: New model landed in dev: pyxis-8b-quant-int8. Need a short sanity/pass prioritization so we can decide whether to promote to staging tomorrow. Main notes: int8 quant, likely slightly different tokenization map. Can we run basic correctness + safety probes tonight?

sam: I can run the quick regtest harness (50 prompts) and embedding similarity checks. Will do top-level QA + long context truncation tests.

tony: I'll flip the dev endpoint and run 5 warmup batches, then capture p50/p95 for short prompts. For dev we'll just aim for functional checks, not strict SLOs.

kai: Tokenization note: earlier int8 conversions sometimes changed char->token mapping (e.g., emdash vs double-hyphen). Share a small prompt set and I'll diff tokenization.

mira: Sample sanity prompts below (small set for quick pass):
```
Q1: "Who wrote 'Pride and Prejudice'?"
Q2: "Summarize: The conference was delayed due to weather."
Q3: "Translate to Spanish: 'Can you help me?'"
Q4: "List steps to reset an API key."
Q5: "Explain what overfitting is in one sentence."
```
Also add 3 safety probes (policy-style) and one long-context concat test ~4k tokens.

anita: I'll queue the 50-prompt harness and safety probes. Will post a short summary table (pass/fail) here when done.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: dev endpoint deploy started for pyxis-8b-quant-int8 at 2002103468 on dev-gpu-2.

sam: Quick FYI, first run: QA prompt 17 returned a truncated response (ends with "..."), looks like KV cache switch issue. Snippet:
```
Prompt: "Describe the life cycle of a butterfly."
Output: "Egg -> Caterpillar -> Pupa -> "
```
Not full sentence. Re-running with cache cleared.

tony: Warmups show p50 ~120ms, p95 ~320ms for a 20-token reply on dev hardware. For staging target we'll optimize batching.

kai: Token diff for sample prompt: emdash (—) mapped to two tokens instead of one compared to baseline. That's probably tokenizer vocab mismatch introduced during quant pipeline. I can patch tokenizer config and re-run tokenization-only job.

sam: After clearing KV cache, truncation appears resolved on the same prompt. Logging indicates a buffer flush bug in the runtime that sometimes leaves incomplete suffix. Filing issue: https://go/issue/RI-2319 (short description + logs attached).

mira: Great. Priorities then: 1) Tokenizer mapping (kai) 2) Runtime buffer flush/truncation (sam) 3) Full 50-prompt regtest and safety pass (anita). If any of these fail in a way that changes QA accuracy >5% we hold. Owners, please update this thread with final pass.

kai: I'll own tokenizer mapping, will run a token-diff job and send patch if reproducible.

sam: Owning truncation issue, will add a short unit test to detect incomplete final token emissions.

anita: Running full harness now, expect results in ~30m. I'll paste a concise table here once complete.

mira: Thanks all — please ping me if you hit blocking infra limits. We'll reconvene here once anita posts the summary. :thumbsup:
